The '''Thodia system''' was located in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Thodian/Legends|Thodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="ShieldOfLies" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thodia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
